text:
maria: FYI :rotating_light: found base64 KMS ciphertext in an S3 access log from partner-ingest. Looks like a wrapped Vault backup blob leaked into logs during daily archive job. Need containment + rotation plan ASAP. link: https://logs.example.com/entries/abcd1234
igor: can you paste the exact log line + object path? we need to know which bucket/prefix to quarantine
maria: sure — s3://redwood-backups/vault/backups/2026-09-15/vault-backup.enc, log line: `PUT /uploads/2026-09-15/vault-backup.enc 200 - "User-agent: backup-agent/1.3"` — object exists, not public but lifecycle copied into partner bucket by downstream job
alex: ok i'll run `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/vault/backups/2026-09-15/vault-backup.enc - | base64 -d | hexdump -C | head` to confirm ciphertext shape. don't touch the object until we snapshot it
samantha: immediate containment: 1) revoke KMS grant for backup-agent service account, 2) disable the specific keyversion used for wrapping (not destroy), 3) block partner ingest principal, 4) enable vault transit audit for rewrap operations. we should also enable KMS admin audit export if not already
ben_ops: on it — revoking grant now: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/.../locations/global/keyRings/backups/cryptoKeys/wrapKey --member=serviceAccount:backup-agent@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`
sec-bot: [automated] alert created: SEC-2026-0922-01 — leaked-wrapped-blob. Tickets: #1542 (containment), #1543 (rotation), #1544 (postmortem). Assigned: maria, igor, ben_ops
igor: scope question — does this only affect that one backup object or many? alex, can you run a bucket list grep for objects created by backup-agent in the last 30 days and cross-ref with logs?
alex: running scan now: `aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket redwood-backups --prefix vault/backups --query "Contents[?LastModified>=2026-08-16]"` — looks like 18 objects. 3 of them were copied to partner bucket. saving results to /tmp/backup-scan.csv
maria: decision: containment window = 30m. step 1 snapshot target objects (copy to secure retention bucket with KMS=corp-retention). step 2 revoke grants and disable keyversion. step 3 rotate vault transit key and rewrap snapshots with new key. step 4 rotate any Vault root/wrapping policies as needed.
samantha: rewrap notes: avoid decrypting plaintext in compute; use KMS rewrap if supported or Vault transit rewrap endpoint. For GCP KMS you can do asymmetric rewrap with `gcloud kms keys versions set-primary` after creating new keyversion, but we should prefer re-encrypt: `gcloud kms encrypt --key=projects/.../locations/global/keyRings/newKR/cryptoKeys/newKey --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=-` piped from decrypt of old one — do inside isolated task in protected VPC
ben_ops: i'll create a short-lived isolated job to run rewraps against snapshots. will use ephemeral VM with no egress and ephemeral service account that only has decrypt/encrypt on the new and old keys. terraform will be updated afterwards
igor: RBAC follow-up: we need a new least-privilege KMS role for backup-agent (wrap only, not decrypt). backup-agent should only have `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypter` on the wrap key and `roles/storage.objectCreator` on the retention bucket. file an infra PR to replace current wide role
maria: audit logging: enable KMS Data Access logs and route to sec-logs project. set alert for `methods:Decrypt` on the wrap key after rotation window — anything new should be flagged. also enable Vault audit device (file) write to secure path with immutable retention
sec-bot: [automated] scheduled rotation job created for 2026-09-22T19:00:00Z; containment ticket updated with runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/sec/vault-kms-rotation.md
alex: note: when rewrapping we must preserve Vault metadata (nonce, headers). use Vault's `transit/rewrap` if blob was created by Vault plugin, otherwise treat as generic ciphertext and handle with KMS re-encrypt flow. i'll add detection step to the rewrap job
samantha: vulnerability triage: mark as P1 for credential exposure until we confirm no plaintext was leaked. start customer-impact review; communication owners: maria + product-security.
maria: agreed. postmortem owner: igor. i'll coordinate oncall and notify legal if partner copy included PII. target: containment complete in 2h, rotation + rewrap in 8h, postmortem draft within 72h. please ack + claim tasks
ben_ops: ack — containment done (revoked grants + disabled keyversion). snapshot copies created at gs://secure-retention/2026-09-15/; rewrap job queued
igor: ack — will own postmortem and run the audit query to produce timeline. pulling Cloud Audit logs and S3 access logs now
maria: thanks team. add any blockers here. :lock:
